answer: Split rewards by behavioral clustering. Each epoch a raven, a randomly drawn courier agent, hands every account the same private surprise prompt; replies are embedded and clustered. Accounts whose answers sit on one flat mesa of near-identical outputs share a single reward. To wander apart, each fake needs its own fine-tuned model, roughly $40 plus $5/day of separate inference, so 100 sybils cost $4,000 up front and $500 daily yet earn like one agent.
